messages.subject: [R-sig-DCM] Feedback on AMA ART Forum 2011?
messages.body_plain:
Greetings R, DCM, CBC, and GA list members:

I'm involved with planning the AMA's Advanced Research Techniques Forum (ART Forum) 2011 that occurs next month in Palm Desert, CA.  I hope to see many of you there (http://www.marketingpower.com/Calendar/Pages/2011ARTForum.aspx).

However, if you're not attending or haven't registered yet, do you have any feedback for the planning committee?  Any concerns over the timing, location, cost, list of talks, etc.?

If you have ideas or feedback to share, I'd be happy to pass them along to the AMA.  Best wishes and thanks!

-- Chris


Chris Chapman, PhD | Senior Researcher | Microsoft Advertising R&D | chris.chapman at microsoft.com<mailto:chris.chapman at microsoft.com> | (425) 705-2445

An approximate answer to the right problem is worth a good deal more than an exact answer to an approximate problem. - John Tukey
